Item.Name: UNIT_ID
Item.Hint: Press [ENTER] to continue; [PRVFLD] to change Unit ID

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from test_orders
 where unit_id = :test_orders.unit_id
 and rownum =1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('0379');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: TEST_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for test ID or use [LISTVAL];

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_seq number(2);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select max(test_seq_no)
 into temp_seq
 from test_orders
 where unit_id = :test_orders.unit_id
 and test_id = :test_orders.test_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 if temp_seq = 1 then
 :test_seq_no := temp_seq;
 GO_ITEM('test_seq_no');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 else
 :test_seq_no := '';
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('test_seq_no',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'test_seq_no', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
end;

 where unit_id = :test_orders.unit_id
 and test_id = :test_orders.test_id
 and test_seq_no = :test_orders.test_seq_no;

 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit_form; 
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);

 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0; 
end;
